mandatory_caveats: Uncertainty calibration is NOT DEMONSTRATED: empirical 1σ coverage ~12.92% vs nominal 68.27%; 2σ ~24.84% vs 95.45%; r(sigma,|error|)~0.2017.
GLORYS12V1 is a numerical ocean reanalysis benchmark (NOT physical ground truth) — assimilates satellite SLA/SST and in-situ profiles.
Independent in-situ ARGO float observations cover only 4 discrete cycle dates in the Arabian Sea (0m depth excluded by float telemetry cutoff). Zero ARGO observations in Bay of Bengal during holdout.

Pooled 4D Pearson r is dominated by vertical temperature gradient (~28°C surface vs ~2°C at 1000m depth) and MUST NOT be interpreted as within-depth spatial correlation skill. Labeled as secondary 4D metric only.
Causal physical interpretations of depth error patterns (e.g., pycnocline dynamics, internal waves) are oceanographic hypotheses — not demonstrated by this audit.
Model TEMPORAL_WINDOW=7 days confirmed. Scaler statistics computed exclusively from pre-holdout training data (days 0–129). Zero data leakage.
Pooled RMSE = sqrt(mean(diff²)) over all jointly finite pairs simultaneously — NOT arithmetic mean of per-depth RMSEs.

details.line_content: - *Caveat 2 (Benchmark Ground Truth):* GLORYS12V1 must never be characterized as "ground truth." It is an eddy-resolving numerical ocean reanalysis model assimilating observational data.
* Numerical ocean reanalysis benchmark (NOT ground truth)

language_audit_note: All flagged "ground truth" occurrences are in correct negation contexts ("NOT ground truth", "must never be characterized as ground truth"). No actual violations detected.
